commit 2283c3e75ce372e9f13c217d40c4d6a29e282bda
Author:     Magnus Melin <mkmelin+mozilla@iki.fi>

CommitDate: Sat Nov 22 12:33:22 2025 +0200

    Bug 1875428 - Explicitely set add-on requireBuiltInCerts prefs to false. r=mkmelin,freaktechnik,kaie
    
    
    This patch disables pinning of ATN certificates for add-on installs and
    add-on updates. It has become a major cause for issues related to add-on
    updates and installs when users use third party security software or SSL
    proxies.
    
    As outlined in the associated bug, the security gain seems to be small
    compared to the negative impact for affected users.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D201827

diff --git a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
index 4bdb9446ab5..0a39d4c7f41 100644
--- a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
+++ b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
@@ -227,6 +227,11 @@ pref("extensions.autoDisableScopes", 15);
 // Enable add-ons installed and owned by the application, like the default theme.
 pref("extensions.startupScanScopes", 4);
 
+// Explicitely set these to false. Firefox end up using a false default as
+// well since the default value is based on whether add-on signing is required.
+pref("extensions.update.requireBuiltInCerts", false);
+pref("extensions.install.requireBuiltInCerts", false);
+
 // Gecko Profiler
 pref("extensions.geckoProfiler.acceptedExtensionIds", "geckoprofiler@mozilla.com,quantum-foxfooding@mozilla.com,raptor@mozilla.org");
title: Bug 1875428 - Explicitely set add-on requireBuiltInCerts prefs to false. r=mkmelin,freaktechnik,kaie
